text:
Alex P: Heads up — can someone cover ARB this Wed 10:30am? I'm oncall Tue/Thu and have a customer call at 11. Proposed condensed agenda:
• 10m — RFC-445 (KV cache guardrails) quick sync + decision
• 15m — quantization policy for dedupe model
• 10m — triage: 99th latency spike on staging
Total ~35m, 10:30-11:05. Preference to keep under 40m. :calendar:
Marta G: I can take facilitation if folks ok. I'll run the RFC-445 bit — Samir can you do quantization?
Samir: Yep I can do quantization. Can we move the KV cache item to the first 8m? it's tight otherwise.
Jules: +1 for Marta. Also can we add a "pre-reads" note — please drop links in the agenda doc so folks can scan before.
Priya: Also suggest adding a short rollback/fallback check for the quantization change (2-3m).
oncall-bot: Reminder: Marta G is scheduled as backup facilitator for this week.
Alex P: Thanks all. Marta, could you post a short agenda doc and set the meeting length to 35m? Also add a small "decision flags" section (what counts as success / rollback trigger).
Alex P: Example agenda template to copy into the doc:
```
Agenda draft:
- Quick context + goal (1m)
- RFC-445 decision (8m)
- Quantization proposal + fallback plan (15m)
- Triage: latency spike (8m)
- Decisions + action owners (3m)
Pre-reads: link to RFC, perf runbook, recent trace sample
Decision flags: perf delta threshold, rollout window, owner
```
Marta G: Will do, posting now. Also quick poll — does Thurs work better for anyone? If so say now.
Samir: Thurs is harder for me. Keep Wed.
Jules: Wed works for me. :thumbsup:
Priya: Wed is fine. I'll prepare the rollback bullets.
Alex P: Great. Last ask — if you own an agenda item, please add a 1-line goal and one slide or perf table in the doc by EOD Tue so reviewers can scan.
Marta G: Posted agenda + doc link: https://docs.internal/redwood/arb/1708201123-agenda — added pre-reads and owners.
Samir: Added the perf table for the quant tests and a short note about expected token throughput.
Alex P: Awesome, thanks. I'll be available asynchronously during the meeting — ping me in thread if you need a quick decision.
Marta G: Thanks everyone — I'll kick at 10:30 and keep us tight. Looking to record outcomes in the doc live.
